title: BNDES credit approved for AI projects (2024 to June 2025)
title_original: Crédito aprovado pelo BNDES para inteligência artificial
summary: Credit for artificial intelligence projects approved by the Brazilian Development Bank (BNDES) between 2024 and June 2025, reported as R$ 1 billion, mostly through the BNDES Mais Inovação programme. By segment, integrators and developers received R$ 561 million, hardware such as chips and supercomputers R$ 258 million, and cloud and data-centre infrastructure R$ 180 million. The figure is approved credit, not disbursements, and relates to the Brazilian AI Plan's goal of financing business AI innovation.
purpose: Loans to companies developing or deploying AI, hardware and AI infrastructure.

sources.title: Em um ano, BNDES aprovou crédito de R$ 1 bilhão para IA
